fields.description: Mercedes-Benz Places by Binghatti is the branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai. Its named suite and penthouse collections draw on Mercedes-Benz models, including the Pagoda, Gullwing and Uhlenhaut Coupé. It is separate from the later twelve-tower Binghatti City community.

overview: The official factsheet describes 150 homes in a 341m tower. Its 4.2m ceiling dimension is slab-to-slab, not finished clear height. Duplex and triplex penthouses form separate collections.
research.locationNote: Downtown Dubai. This is the earlier single-tower collaboration; do not import Binghatti City’s Nad Al Sheba location or tower-specific calendar.
research.priceNote: The developer branded collection advertises AED 11,499,999, matching Property Finder’s precise body reference. The factsheet’s average AED-per-square-foot figures are a different metric and are not multiplied into a supposed current unit price.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20% at launch, 50% construction and 30% handover. This is an attributed portal guide, not a verified dated offer or resale account statement.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts February 2027, including 28 February in its timeline. Obtain the selected unit’s signed completion date and current construction evidence; no completed claim is made.
unresolved: Confirm current availability, current contractual completion, payment dates, parking, services and approved operating budget. Furnished/unfurnished options in the original factsheet are not a universal furnishing promise.

Factsheet total bands differ from individual mirror drawings. The four-bedroom mirror panel prints 372m²/3,007ft² despite components totalling 4,008ft²; excluded as inconsistent. Do not silently convert or combine these versions.

The factsheet says the tower aims for LEED qualification. Achieved certification was not verified. Private pools and penthouse parking depend on the selected plan; services may be charged separately. Images remain illustrative.
